Name: Theophilus
Summary: Theophilus was the most excellent recipient to whom Luke addressed both his Gospel and the book of Acts, so that he might know the certainty of the things he had been taught.
KeyStory: Luke wrote to Theophilus in order, that he might know the certainty of the things he had been taught.
LifeLesson: Luke wrote for certainty, not for feeling. Theophilus reminds us that faith loves an orderly account.
